channel.title: The Dig — NISQ algorithms
channel.description: Papers relevant to operating, benchmarking, integrating and using a semiconductor spin-qubit quantum computer of at least 16 qubits that is co-located with and integrated into an HPC system. Today's arXiv announcement, ranked against the NISQ algorithms preset. Today’s ranked reading list has two entries: 2611.14114 leads as a directly relevant benchmark for GHZ-state generation on the spin-qubit QPU, showing that median calibration data can poorly predict entanglement outcomes and supporting periodic benchmarking and calibration-state validation; 2611.14391 follows as a useful adjacent superconducting-platform result on rapid on-chip reset and leakage removal that may inform spin-qubit initialization but does not directly alter spin-qubit operation or HPC integration.
